description: This file defines the EventLoopGroup class in the AWS SDK for PHP, representing a group of event loops for performing I/O and background tasks, typically used for managing threading in network operations.

classes.name: EventLoopGroup
classes.description: Represents one or more event loops (one per thread) for doing I/O and background tasks in AWS PHP SDK. It manages threading and event dispatching.

methods.name: defaults
methods.description: Provides the default options for EventLoopGroup, such as maximum number of threads.
